* WHERE...North Central Fairfield County in central Ohio...
South Central Licking County in central Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 1015 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying

remain closed due to flooding. Streams continue to rise due to
excess runoff from earlier rainfall.

reported flooding in the warned area due to ongoing overland and
river flooding. Flooding will continue through the overnight
hours into Friday morning.

Buckeye Lake, Hebron, Millersport, Fairfield Beach, Harbor Hills,
Etna, and Kirkersville. This includes Interstate 70 at State
Routes 158, 37, 79, and 13.

deaths occur in vehicles.

dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 21 at 5:08AM EDT until August 21 at 5:45AM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
properties.description:
SVRGSP

The National Weather Service in Greenville-Spartanburg has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Franklin County in northeastern Georgia...
Stephens County in northeastern Georgia...
Eastern Habersham County in northeastern Georgia...
Central Rabun County in northeastern Georgia...
Northwestern Hart County in northeastern Georgia...
Central Oconee County in Upstate South Carolina...

* Until 545 AM EDT.

* At 508 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Clayton to 13 miles east of Clarkesville to 4
miles southwest of Toccoa, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind
damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Toccoa, Walhalla, Clayton, Carnesville, Westminster, Lavonia,
Gumlog, Mountain City, Bowersville, and Tiger.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Please report damaging winds, hail, or flooding to the National
Weather Service by calling toll free, 1, 800, 2 6 7, 8 1 0 1, or by
posting on our Facebook page, or post it to X using hashtag nwsgsp.
Your message should describe the event and the specific location
where it occurred.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 20 at 10:50PM MST until August 21 at 3:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 1050 PM MST /1150 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated that heavy rain
has moved out of the warned area. Between 0.75 and 1.25 inches of
rain fell earlier this evening, but only light additional rainfall is
expected. Flooding impacts will continue.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River south to near
Marble Canyon.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Vermilion Cliffs National Monument and Lees Ferry.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 0 and 2.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lee's Ferry Campground, Lees Ferry Campground, Paria Beach Camp Site
and Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Cathedral Wash and Paria River.
properties.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will flow down
the Paria River to the confluence with the Colorado River at Lees
Ferry.
